verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents an official CLI on its integrations page that lets users create inboxes, send messages, and manage threads without writing code, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. The evidence is a single short docs excerpt, though, with no detail on commands or agent-friendly behaviour. missing for 10: detail on installation, command coverage and AI-oriented output modes (e.g. machine-readable output), plus independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
